design: Exact W-R57 model/training/measurement procedures on new independent synthetic development and sealed cohorts. Amplitudes1,2,3 (source-valid), 9 models each with withheld generator and balanced positive/negative presentations, identity and XOR55. No adaptive tuning.
criterion: SOURCE_SPECIFIC_REPLICATION iff all 9 xorshift-withheld accuracy cells>=0.65; PARTIAL_REPLICATION iff all >=0.55; OTHERWISE_NEGATIVE. Any broad generalization requires >=2 of3 withheld families >=55% in every amplitude/cohort separately. Preserve all negatives.
controls: Previously sealed cohorts never reused. Source and prereg hash check. Original artifact and full go test/build. FORGE seed reservations disjoint. No accepted-ref, FSA or controller promotion.
